_note: 2026-09-29 (Beth): 21 chains. Atelier 7 (notions, fabric, jewelry, gowns, hats, footwear, purses). The Gardens (park namespace) 4 outdoors-only chains (seeds, topiary, masonry, ornaments). Estate board / Craftsman's Court 7 (timber, stonework, furniture, decor, ironwork, household, carriages). Conservatory 3 (cultivar, foliage, vessels). Chain lengths vary 10-15 (never all the same); each chain merges only to its own final level.
